description: This file defines the NavigationAdapter class for an Android application, which manages the display and interaction of navigation items within a RecyclerView. It handles item rendering, selection, and branding customization.

classes.name: NavigationAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for managing navigation items in a RecyclerView, including item rendering, selection, and branding.

methods.name: NavigationAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context and click listener, setting default brand color.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Updates the brand color and refreshes the view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new NavigationViewHolder for a navigation item.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a specific position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of navigation items.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Sets the list of navigation items, assigning default values for uncategorized items.

methods.name: setSelectedItem
methods.description: Sets the currently selected item by ID.
